pages.title: Older Than Trouble
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This is an optional challenge in the creature’s native setting. Obtain access and summon it normally; it does not replace the main campaign.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Search jungle biomes for the Temple to Methuselah; explore its chambers to reach the boss. Entrance to the time-travel unlock path.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Defeat the Methuselah boss in the temple and collect its eye. Eye needed to activate a completed forgotten portal.
